prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing.

a warm caramel complexion, early 30s goddess, powerlifter physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — an enormous, overwhelmingly powerful woman; colossal thick trapezius muscle rising high around her neck, massive round boulder shoulders, enormous thick arms with dense hard muscle, a broad powerful back, a deeply carved abdomen, colossal glutes and hips extending far beyond the shoulders, gigantic quadriceps with a deep sweep; her head looks small on top of her massive frame; not slim, not a fitness body, powerful and heavy at once; her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other, shaggy layered rose pink hair — wearing a skin-tight glossy red latex ultra-mini skirt ending at the very top of her thighs with a slit cut up the left side all the way to the hip bone, paired with a black leather balconette bra with molded lifting cups, a lace-up front and thin straps, a narrow band under the cups and nothing below it, her whole stomach bare and fully visible, the cups fully covering her bust. Pose: standing full height, both arms slightly spread commanding the frame — most extreme powerlifter silhouette ever displayed.
Footwear: heels of the most absurdly extreme height imaginable, strappy platform stiletto sandals made of glossy red latex, each with a razor-thin tapered heel a full forty inches tall and a twelve-inch hidden front platform, her feet arched fully vertical on the very tips of her toes like a dancer on pointe, her legs stretched impossibly long and her whole body lifted far above the ground on them as if standing on stilts.
Nails: the longest nails physically imaginable, coffin nails each as long as her forearm is wide, in glossy red latex with a high polish.
Jewelry: a fine gold chain looped around her thigh above the knee, a long layered gold necklace falling between her breasts, and a delicate silver body chain draped across her collarbones and down her torso. Jewelry is metal and pearl only, worn on the body, nothing added to her face or ears.
Face: her face is bare of any garment — real living flesh with real pores, a soft sheen of natural oils and bright real catchlights, the face of a real Latina woman with high cheekbones, large dark eyes and full lips, an unmistakably feminine face with a calm, composed expression, makeup: heavy pink-red eyeshadow smudged wide beneath both eyes like crying, faint tear-track blush running down the cheeks, large eyes with bright real catchlights, long lashes, glossy dark-cherry lips.

Background: a bright grand hall with a pale marble floor, tall columns, standard-height arched doors and soft golden daylight, bright and evenly lit, shadows soft, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, NO dark background NO black void. ONE woman only. Extreme macro detail on the fabric texture, the skin and the shadows. Full-length wide shot from a moderate distance with the camera at waist height, the whole figure from the soles of the boots to the top of her head completely visible, with the door, railing or steps beside her at normal human scale so the extreme heel height reads at a glance, the towering heels clearly separating the boot soles from the floor. 8K portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
